theme: HMLR INSPIRE publication geometry duplication and projection controls
verified_controls: new files are published on the first Sunday of each month
files are distributed by local authority as GML
INSPIRE polygons represent indicative extent and position of registered freehold properties
a polygon on a local-authority boundary appears in both authority files
INSPIRE geometry does not establish the full legal extent of a registered title
one registered title may contain several polygons
each polygon has a distinct Land Registry INSPIRE ID
dataset uses British National Grid geometry
reprojection to web mapping CRS may introduce positional error
cross-authority duplicate IDs require de-duplication before parcel binding
INSPIRE geometry is retained only as candidate parcel-binding evidence until revision14 runtime integrity is verified
